title: Yijie Qian joins the team
body: Yijie Qian joined Tyndall as a Research Assistant in September 2026.

title: Tyndall abstract accepted for EPoSS Annual Forum 2026
body: Tyndall announced acceptance of a paper abstract for the forum in Braga, Portugal. The author team includes Raúl Henares Vargas, Cian Ó Mathúna and Yi Dou, with colleagues across the institute.

title: Chenyang Zhang joins the team
body: Chenyang Zhang joined Tyndall in May 2026, working on physics-guided and data-driven modelling for integrated magnetics and power electronic systems.

title: Raúl Henares Vargas at APEC 2026
body: Raúl shared his first APEC presentation in San Antonio, in the Magnetic Application session, and his support for the Tyndall exhibition booth.

title: Tyndall at PwrSoC 2025 in Seoul
body: Tyndall highlighted its participation in the International Workshop on Power Supply on Chip in Seoul, which brought together 210 experts in integrated power technologies. Its update features Cian Ó Mathúna and Yi Dou.

title: Yi Dou joins as Senior Researcher
body: Yi Dou took up the Senior Researcher role at Tyndall in January 2025.
